title: cousinia odontolepis subsp. kurdica
intro: Cousinia odontolepis subsp. kurdica, commonly known as Kurd Cousinia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to the mountainous regions of Kurdistan. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cousinia odontolepis subsp. kurdica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
